<ApiTitle method="post" title="Generate Deliverable" />

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/deliverable"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Generates a new document from a template by filling its placeholders with the variable values you send, and stores it as a deliverable with a PDF copy. The response includes a `placeholderReport` listing template placeholders you sent no value for and values you sent that the template does not use.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
